description:
Screenshot of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CLC+ Query Builder interface, specifically the "Text" tab, used for defining rules for "Output Class '2 - FL Deciduous'". The interface displays a rule editor with a main rule expression area, a "Rule Structure" section providing syntax guidance, and an "Examples" section.

The main rule, commented as "# Intersect HRL with CLC+ BB classes", is composed of two conditional blocks joined by the logical operator '&&' (AND). These conditions use `sumCov` functions to check the percentage coverage of specified EAGLE elements and their associated barcodes:
1. The first conditional block is: `(sumCov("LCC-trees", 5) >= 30 && sumCov("LCH-broad-leaved", 2) >= 30)`. This requires the summed coverage of "LCC-trees" with barcode '5' to be at least 30% AND the summed coverage of "LCH-broad-leaved" with barcode '2' to be at least 30%.
2. The second conditional block is: `(sumCov("LCC-trees", 5) >= 30 && sumCov("LCH-deciduous", 5) >= 30 && sumCov("LCH-broad-leaved", 5) >= 30)`. This requires the summed coverage of "LCC-trees" (barcode 5), "LCH-deciduous" (barcode 5), and "LCH-broad-leaved" (barcode 5) to each be at least 30%.

The "Rule Structure" section provides generic syntax for `firstCov` expressions:
- `firstCov("<EAGLE_ELEMENT_IDENTIFIER>", <BARCODE>) <OPERATOR> firstCov("<EAGLE_ELEMENT_IDENTIFIER>", <BARCODE>)...`
- `firstCov("<EAGLE_ELEMENT_IDENTIFIER>", <BARCODE> [|| <BARCODE>|*]) <OPERATOR> <VALUE>...`

The "Examples" section clarifies rule formulation:
- "When comparing coverage against coverage, only one barcode is allowed in each coverage expression," as shown in `firstCov("LCC-water", 3) >= firstCov("LCC-trees", 5)`.
- "When comparing coverage against value, multiple barcodes are allowed," as shown in `firstCov("LCC-water", 3 || 4 || 5) >= 30`. Partially visible text indicates that this comparison with multiple barcodes is equivalent to an OR-connected ruleset.

The interface also includes buttons for "Computation manual" and "EAGLE-Elements", along with "CANCEL" and "ADD" action buttons.
